sources.supports: General background, Force sensitivity, and role in Star Wars Rebels.

Pushes and pulls objects using the Force.

weaknesses: Lacks formal mystical training despite latent Force sensitivity
limitations: Prone to initial panic when facing overwhelming First Order forces

characters.summary: General Grievous is a cyborg Supreme Commander of the droid armies who utilizes his multi-armed anatomy, four spinning lightsabers, and relentless aggression to overwhelm Jedi opponents.

mechanisms: Cyborg armor plating resistant to glancing blows
Flexible articulation to block from multiple angles

weaknesses: Exposed biological organs in his chest cavity vulnerable to direct penetration or crushing
limitations: Prone to coughing fits from previous internal damage
Susceptible to being outmaneuvered by skilled Force users

sources.supports: Cyborg nature, lightsaber combat capabilities, and role in the Clone Wars.

feats.claim: Slaughtered numerous Jedi knights and collected their lightsabers as trophies.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Defeated after being shot in his exposed chest cavity with a blaster

campaignTags.claim: Retains only organic organs inside a largely robotic body.
Pilots custom starfighters like the Soulless One.

unknowns: Exact durability limits against sustained heavy artillery
